meta.rowShape: one row per resourceType x settingsVariant x role: granted = {privilege: "<path>|<rule name>"}; every privilege in relevantPrivileges[resourceType] that is absent from granted is denied. Expand to {resourceType, settingsVariant, role, privilege, granted, path, evidence} by iterating granted (evidence = evidence[rule name]) and denied. Rows exist only for the variants whose outcome table differs; equivalentVariants maps every variant to its row-bearing twin. Roles are scoped per resource family (see rolesPerFamily).
meta.pathVocabulary: direct | cascade(<origin resource>) | parent-credential | derived-credential | type-only | data-dependent | settings:<flag> | privilege-rule(<source>-><granted>)

registered.note: a signed-in user with no role on the resource (holds global-registered, user-self on itself, account-admin on its own account)

account-admin.note: owner/admin of the account hosting the space tree (a user host, or the owners/admins of the hosting organisation)

subspace-admin-derived@L0.note: holds only the derived space-subspace-admin credential of L0 (what every L1 admin is given on the parent) plus L0 membership

creator-member@L1.note: the user who created the content (createdBy), still an L1 member

creator-former-member.note: the user who created the content, no longer a member anywhere

virtual-contributor-member@L1.note: a VC assigned member on L0 and L1; VCs hold no global-registered credential

vc-account-admin.note: admin of the account that owns the virtual contributor

user-self.note: the user whose own user/profile/settings are the resource

applicant.note: the user who submitted the application

invited-actor-account-admin.note: the account admin of the invited actor (a user is admin of its own account)

pub-open.description: all three levels public / open, every flag off

priv-applications.description: all three levels private / applications, every flag off (the L0 server default)

defaults.description: server defaults: L0 private / applications / subspace-admins-invite; subspaces public / open / inherit / members-create

t-pub-pub.description: storage-suite shape: L0 public/applications; L1 public/open with inherit on, members-create off; L2 subspace defaults

t-pub-priv.description: storage-suite shape: L0 public; L1 PRIVATE/open with inherit on; L2 subspace defaults

t-priv-pub.description: storage-suite shape: L0 PRIVATE; L1 public/open with inherit on; L2 subspace defaults

t-priv-priv.description: storage-suite shape: L0 PRIVATE; L1 PRIVATE/open with inherit on; L2 subspace defaults

pub-open+support.description: pub-open with allowPlatformSupportAsAdmin on the L0

priv-applications+support.description: priv-applications with allowPlatformSupportAsAdmin on the L0, user-hosted account (the A15 twin)

pub-open+members.description: pub-open with allowMembersToCreateCallouts, allowMembersToCreateSubspaces and inheritMembershipRights on every level

pub-applications.description: all public with membership policy applications

pub-invitations.description: all public with membership policy invitations

combined-apply.description: L0 private/applications; L1 public/applications with allowSubspaceAdminsToInviteMembers; L2 public/applications (the combined apply path)

pub-open+guests.description: pub-open with allowGuestContributions on every level and guest access enabled on the whiteboard

trusted-org.description: pub-open with ORG in the L0 trustedOrganizations

L0pub-L1pub-L2priv.description: L0 and L1 public/open, L2 private/applications

user-hosted.description: pub-open on a user-hosted account (no platform-support-org-resources cascade)
